summary.text: Wayne MacDonald is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 16 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
He chaired the House Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee in the 2023-2024 session.

paragraphs.text: Wayne MacDonald was born in Derry, New Hampshire, and earned a B.A. in political science from Saint Anselm College in 1976 and an M.B.A. from Rivier University in 1987.
His career experience includes work as a senior fraud investigator with the New Hampshire Department of Health and Human Services and as manager of Standard Sash and Door Company.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2020.
He was vice chair of the Election Law Committee and served on the Special Committee on Redistricting in 2021-2022, and chaired the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee in 2023-2024.
